WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.transref,
        t.tradekind,
        AVG(sf.optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
    INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
    INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt
    FROM pair_averages
),
pair_deviations AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.transref,
        pa.tradekind,
        pa.pair_avg_optvolrt,
        oa.overall_avg_optvolrt,
        ABS(pa.pair_avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt) as pair_deviation
    FROM pair_averages pa
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE oa.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
type_avg_deviations AS (
    SELECT 
        tradekind,
        AVG(pair_deviation) as type_avg_deviation
    FROM pair_deviations
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.transref,
        pd.tradekind,
        pd.pair_avg_optvolrt,
        pd.pair_deviation,
        tad.type_avg_deviation,
        tad.type_avg_deviation - pd.pair_deviation as excess
    FROM pair_deviations pd
    INNER JOIN type_avg_deviations tad ON pd.tradekind = tad.tradekind
    WHERE pd.pair_deviation < tad.type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt,
    AVG(pair_deviation) as avg_deviation,
    AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
